test_vector_casting: test the pybind11 std::vector to Python list bidirectional casting using cast_vector and load_vector
test_map_casting: test the pybind11 std::map to Python dict bidirectional casting using cast_map and load_map
test_optional_casting: test the pybind11 std::optional to Python None conversion using double_or_zero and half_or_none
test_recursive_casting: test pybind11 STL casters preserving lvalue and rvalue context for nested container values
test_variant_casting: test the pybind11 std::variant type dispatch using load_variant with int, str, float, and None
